vedic_reference.note: Sailee is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Saraswati' and 'Chandra', representing the Moon Goddess and the Goddess of Knowledge, respectively. In Hindu mythology, Saraswati is considered the goddess of wisdom, learning, music, and the arts. Chandra, on the other hand, is the god of the moon, and is often associated with peace, tranquility, and the natural cycle of life. Together, these two deities form the basis for the name Sailee, which embodies the combination of knowledge, wisdom, and the tranquil power of the moon.
